title: A Phase II Evaluation of the Efficacy and Safety of Sacituzumab Govitecan in Patients with Recurrent Uterine Cancer.
caption: IHC characteristics and response ( n  = 43). Archival tumor was stained with the anti–Trop-2  EPR20043  antibody. Membrane H-score versus best response (top) or tumor volume change at best response (middle). Kaplan–Meier estimates of PFS by median H-score (bottom).
